caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate set against a light beige background. The plate itself is colored in muted tones of brown, tan, and gray, with shading suggesting a slightly glossy, ceramic or metallic surface. In the center of the plate, there is a symmetrical, stylized motif consisting of five brown leaves arranged in a radial pattern, each leaf pointing outward and having distinct serrated edges. At the core of the motif is a white, five-pointed star surrounded by the leaves. Around the rim of the plate, along the inner circumference, there is handwritten text in a cursive script in dark brown ink. Additional text and what appears to be a date ("1822") can be seen along the left inner edge, as well as a signature in the lower right portion within the plate's border. The overall color palette consists of earthy browns, tans, and muted grays, contrasted with the white of the central star.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
